description: The plot illustrates the mean absolute values before and after gating. The x-axis is unlabeled and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis is also unlabeled and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. There are three lines in the plot: a black dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, with an average value of 0.03, a black dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, with an average value of 0.44, and a green dashed line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, with an average value of 0.33. The black dashed line starts at approximately 0.03 and remains relatively stable across the x-axis. The black dotted line starts at around 1.0 and decreases to approximately 0.2. The green dashed line starts at around 0.8 and decreases to approximately 0.2.
